name: Size Chart
summary: Centered product size-reference Modal composing a required target-authored static Data Table, optional Segmented Control presentation choice, and optional notes.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Stable product-profile wrapper with no independent landmark or widget role.

anatomy.name: trigger
anatomy.description: Canonical link-style Button that invokes the named modal while the component is closed.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: D7 hook on the canonical centered Modal overlay while the component is open; a native target may map this owner to dialog modality.

anatomy.name: dialog
anatomy.description: D7 hook on the canonical named Modal dialog while open.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Canonical Modal body arranging the optional unit choice, required chart and optional notes.

anatomy.name: unitControls
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Segmented Control for mutually exclusive authored presentations.

anatomy.name: chart
anatomy.description: Required named canonical Data Table overflow owner containing one complete target-authored size matrix.

anatomy.name: notes
anatomy.description: Optional target-authored fit, method, approximation, tolerance or variation prose.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Canonical centered Modal size-reference profile at every Web viewport; Sheet and inline presentation are different target compositions, not D7 variants.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic composition using canonical Modal and Data Table sizing.

states.name: closed
states.description: Only the canonical invoker is available.

states.name: open
states.description: The named canonical Modal and required chart are available.

states.name: withUnitChoice
states.description: Optional canonical exclusive choice coordinates a complete authored table replacement.

states.name: withNotes
states.description: Optional target-authored supporting guidance follows the chart.

behavior.name: modalComposition
behavior.description: Canonical centered Modal owns naming, visible dismiss action, content-appropriate initial focus, Tab containment, Escape, focus restoration and target-owned outside inertness/lifecycle at every Web viewport.

behavior.name: structuredInitialFocus
behavior.description: Because content includes a table and may include multiple paragraphs, targets initially focus the static visible title and let users explore structure instead of flattening it into aria-describedby.

behavior.name: unitChoiceComposition
behavior.description: Optional unit choice composes canonical Segmented Control. The target owns one selected value and replaces the complete authored chart; D7 owns no second state or conversion.

behavior.name: measurementTable
behavior.description: The target supplies one complete canonical static Data Table with meaningful caption and header relationships; D7 prescribes no column schema and does not use grid semantics.

behavior.name: contentReplacement
behavior.description: A target may coordinate selected unit with a separately authored complete chart. D7 does not parse, calculate, convert, round, localize, persist, synchronize or announce measurement values.

behavior.name: boundedPresentation
behavior.description: D7 preserves one complete static table inside the centered Modal. A very large matrix requires a different target presentation; D7 does not virtualize, transpose, split or transform table structure at a breakpoint.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: Empty trigger label, title, dismiss label or chart omits the complete Size Chart rather than exposing an unusable modal shell.

properties.name: triggerLabel
properties.description: Non-empty visible localized label for the canonical modal invoker.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Non-empty visible localized Modal title and accessible-name source.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Contextual localized accessible name for the canonical visible dismiss action.

properties.name: chart
properties.description: Required non-empty canonical Data Table composition containing one complete localized target-authored size matrix; D7 defines no raw data or conversion schema.

properties.name: unitControls
properties.description: Optional canonical Segmented Control; the target owns selected value and complete-chart replacement.

properties.name: notes
properties.description: Optional target-authored fit, method, approximation, tolerance or variation prose; ordinary content, not a live region by default.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the target presents the Size Chart Modal. Focus, inertness, dismissal, scroll locking and lifecycle remain target-owned.

accessibility: Compose canonical Modal with a visible title, named visible close action, content-appropriate title focus, contained Tab sequence, Escape dismissal, outside inertness and focus restoration.
Omit aria-describedby by default because the dialog contains a table and may contain multiple paragraphs that need structural navigation.
Compose a canonical Data Table with meaningful caption, scoped column and row headers, and a named keyboard-focusable overflow owner when needed.
Keep the measurement matrix a static native table rather than an interactive ARIA grid.
Compose optional unit choice with a visible legend, same-name native radios and exactly one checked value.
Do not use color, position, abbreviation or placeholder text as the only carrier of size, quantity, unit, approximation or tolerance meaning.
Keep long, localized, bidirectional and enlarged content reachable without clipping; use bdi for independently formatted values when needed.
Do not add a live region for the complete table by default; a target with evidence owns concise, non-duplicative update feedback.
Honor canonical dependency focus, forced-colors and reduced-motion behavior.

web.notes: Composes the canonical centered Modal at every Web viewport plus Segmented Control and Data Table CSS; D7 adds only intrinsic content flow and native-dialog target normalization. Lifecycle remains target-owned.

shopify.notes: Main Product can render size-chart.liquid from product.metafields.custom.size_chart. A bounded merchant-owned metaobject supplies one required and one optional complete three-column table, localized notes and at most twenty valid rows per presentation; size-chart.js maps canonical behavior to native dialog modality without conversion.

react.notes: The docs target uses shared SizeChartArtwork with canonical ModalArtwork, SegmentedControlArtwork and DataTableArtwork for both Exhibit and Studio.
